```{r}
library(flashier.utils)
set.seed(4)
X <- tcrossprod(matrix(rnorm(40),20,2),matrix(rnorm(12),6,2)) + matrix(rnorm(120,sd=0.1),20,6)
dimnames(X) <- list(paste0("s",1:20),paste0("f",1:6))
fit <- fit_ebmf(X,"rows",max_factors=2,seed=1,nullcheck=FALSE,backfit=TRUE,verbose=0,
                ebnm_fn=list(ebnm::ebnm_normal,ebnm::ebnm_point_laplace))
view <- standardize_factors(fit)
factor_intervals(fit,"activity",factors="F1",ids="s1",nsamp=20,seed=1)
D <- matrix(rnorm(20*ncol(view$activity)),20,dimnames=list(NULL,colnames(view$activity)))
backproject_contrast(view,D,"draws",factor_basis=view$manifest)$effects
```

Native variational draws condition on learned priors. Coefficient draws hold
feature programs fixed and are a separate source of uncertainty. Their arbitrary
pairing is not a joint posterior. For covariance inputs supply the full named
factor covariance; marginal SE alone cannot recover it. Bootstrap uncertainty is
a separately declared pipeline workflow. Exact quantile storage is bounded at
256 MiB, and projected draws process one selected contrast per call in feature
blocks. Sign probability means P(theta greater than zero).
